calculators.name: Roll Forming - Coil Material Stock
calculators.description: Coil Material Stock, per part: the coil as supplied (memory operation As Supplied), on the line for the part's run. The line runs at one speed, the slowest of its limits (Roll Forming - Line Speed), so every machine on it is busy for the part's feed length (the part plus the cut-off slug) at that speed, plus its share of the line's stoppages: the coil change and the press dies' re-sharpening (the line stands still for both). The rule is the engine's own (the data has no cycle formula), agreed with the user 2026-11-22.

source.engine: feed_length_mm (the part length plus the cut-off slug: Roll Forming - Strip)
line_speed_mm_s (Roll Forming - Line Speed: the slowest of the line's limits)
coil_change_s (Roll Forming - Coil Change: the line stopped for each coil, over the parts a coil makes)
die_sharpening_s (Roll Forming - Die Sharpening: the line stopped to re-sharpen the press dies)

fields.name: Stoppage per Part
fields.formula: {Coil Change per Part} + {Die Sharpening per Part}

calculators.name: Roll Forming - Stations
calculators.description: The roll stations a profile needs: the forming passes of its bends (grouped by precedence level, level k being k bends out from the web, the widest flat; each level ceil(its largest angle / rollFormingLiftAngle) passes), a lead-in pass for a strip thicker than leadInRollStationThicknessThreshold, and the finishing passes of the cross-section tolerance (toleranceThresholds, crossSectionTolerance). The Cost Guide's rollFormStations replaces the result. The level rule is the engine's own (the data gives the lift per pass, no formula), agreed with the user 2026-11-22.

source.engine: forming_passes (each bend level: ceil(its largest angle / rollFormingLiftAngle))
finishing_passes (toleranceThresholds: the crossSectionTolerance row's Number of Finishing Passes)

calculators.name: Roll Forming - Line Speed
calculators.description: The speed the line runs at: the slowest of the line's machines (each one's max line speed: the mill, the uncoiler, the flattener, the welder), the part-length tolerance's (partLengthToleranceThresholds for cutOffMeasurementSystem and partLengthTolerance), profileRollBendingSpeed on a curved profile, and the slowest stationary-die press (its strokes a minute x stationaryDieLineSpeedFactor, one stroke a part of the feed length), times the cross-section tolerance's Line Speed Multiplier. The rule is the engine's own, agreed with the user 2026-11-22.

source.engine: machine_line_speed_mm_s (the slowest max line speed of the line's machines)
part_length_tolerance_speed (partLengthToleranceThresholds: the measurement system and tolerance's Maximum Line Speed)
curved (1 when the profile is curved, else 0)
press_count (1 when a stationary-die press is on the line, else 0)
press_strokes_per_minute (the slowest stationary-die press on the line)
feed_length_mm (the part length plus the cut-off slug)
line_speed_multiplier (toleranceThresholds: the crossSectionTolerance row's Line Speed Multiplier)

fields.name: Press Line Speed
fields.formula: {Press Strokes per Minute} * {Stationary Die Speed Factor} * {Feed Length} / 60

fields.name: Uncapped Speed
fields.formula: min({Machine Line Speed}, {Part Length Tolerance Speed})

fields.name: Curve Capped Speed
fields.formula: IF({Curved} > 0, min({Uncapped Speed}, {Profile Bending Speed}), {Uncapped Speed})

fields.name: Press Capped Speed
fields.formula: IF({Press Count} > 0, min({Curve Capped Speed}, {Press Line Speed}), {Curve Capped Speed})

calculators.name: Roll Forming - Coil Change
calculators.description: The line stopped for each new coil, shared by the parts a coil makes: the coil (the annulus between stockCoilInnerDiameter and stockCoilOuterDiameter, as wide as the strip, no heavier than the uncoiler holds) over the strip a part uses; each change threads the new coil (coilThreadingTime) or, for a strip thicker than coilEndWeldingThicknessThreshold, welds it to the last (coilEndWeldTime), plus the uncoiler's coil load time. The rule is the engine's own, agreed with the user 2026-11-22.

source.engine: strip_mass_kg (Roll Forming - Strip)

fields.name: Full Coil Mass
fields.formula: pi / 4 * ({Coil Outer Diameter} ^ 2 - {Coil Inner Diameter} ^ 2) * {Strip Width} * {Density} / 1000000000

fields.name: Coil Change Time
fields.formula: IF({Sheet Thickness} > {End Weld Thickness Threshold}, {Coil End Weld Time}, {Coil Threading Time}) + {Coil Load Time}

calculators.name: Roll Forming - Die Sharpening
calculators.description: The line stopped to re-sharpen the stationary press dies, shared by the parts between: stationaryDieChangeoverTime every numHitsPerDieChangePunchPress hits of the punch press's die and every numHitsPerDieChangeCutOffPress hits of the cut-off die, one hit a part each.

source.engine: punch_dies (1 when the strip is punched, else 0)
cut_off_dies (the cut-off die: 1)

fields.name: Die Sharpening per Part
fields.formula: {Die Changeover Time} * ({Punch Dies} / {Punch Hits per Die Change} + {Cut-Off Dies} / {Cut-Off Hits per Die Change})

calculators.name: Roll Forming - Strip
calculators.description: The strip one part uses: as wide as the section's stretch-out, as long as the part plus the slug a blade cut-off cuts out between parts (slugDieCutOffLength; none by scissor), at the sheet's thickness and the material's density.

source.engine: slug_mm (slugDieCutOffLength by blade, 0 by scissor)

calculators.name: Roll Forming - Material
calculators.description: The material of one part: the strip it uses off the coil (Roll Forming - Strip; the slug and the punched area are its scrap), at the material's price.

source.engine: strip_mass_kg (Roll Forming - Strip)

calculators.name: Roll Forming - Press Force
calculators.description: The force of a press stroke on the line: the length it cuts (the punched features' perimeters in one stroke of the progressive die; the strip width once by scissor, twice by blade), sheared through the sheet at the material's shear strength.

source.engine: cut_length_mm (the length one stroke cuts)

calculators.name: Roll Forming - Roll Tooling
calculators.description: One set of the mill's rolls: the tooling multiplier (toolingMultiplier_Standard, or toolingMultiplier_Panel for a panel profile; the Cost Guide's rollFormToolingMultiplier when set) x the strip width x the roll stations, with profit and SG&A. The data gives the multipliers (design, material and machining) and no formula: this rule is the engine's own, agreed with the user 2026-11-22.

source.engine: tooling_multiplier (toolingMultiplier_Standard or toolingMultiplier_Panel; the Cost Guide's rollFormToolingMultiplier)
roll_stations (Roll Forming - Stations, or the Cost Guide's rollFormStations)

calculators.name: Roll Forming - Press Die
calculators.description: One die of a press on the line (the punch press's progressive die, or the cut-off die), by a compact die model: its design (punchPressDesignPreparationHrs + punchPressDieBaseDesignHrs) and assembly (punchPressToolingAssemblyHrs) at the tool shop's rates; its upper and lower die shoes (dieShoeSizes for the die's plan) in tool steel and their machining (cncMillingRates profiling); the standard components of each punched feature (componentStandardCosts: pierce punch, die button, punch retainer, stripper pin); the cut-off's blade or scissor inserts (toolingComponentAttributes); the die's carrying, freight, gage and welding costs; heat treatment when cutOffToolingHeatTreat / punchToolingHeatTreat says so; tuning on the cut-off die (percentTuning); with profit and SG&A. Shop rates and tool steel: the Digital Factory USA Default tool shop. The model is the engine's own, agreed with the user 2026-11-22.

source.engine: design_rate (the tool shop's designRateUsdPerHr)
assembly_rate (the tool shop's assemblyRateUsdPerHr)
shoe_steel_kg (dieShoeSizes for the die's plan: upper and lower shoe at the tool steel's density)
shoe_area_mm2 (the two shoes' faces)
profiling_rate (cncMillingRates at the shoe area)
machining_rate (the tool shop's machiningRateUsdPerHr)
steel_price (the tool shop's default tool material)
punched_features (the features the die punches; 0 for the cut-off die)
punch_cost (componentStandardCosts piercePunchStandard)
button_cost (componentStandardCosts dieButton)
retainer_cost (componentStandardCosts piercePunchRetainerStandard)
stripper_pin_cost (componentStandardCosts stripperPinAssy)
insert_steel_kg (the cut-off's blade or scissor inserts, toolingComponentAttributes; 0 for the punch die)
heat_treat (cutOffToolingHeatTreat or punchToolingHeatTreat: 1 or 0)
other_costs (the die's carrying, freight, gage and welding cost variables)
tuning (percentTuning on the cut-off die, 0 on the punch die)

fields.name: Shoe Cost
fields.formula: {Shoe Steel Mass} * {Steel Price} + {Shoe Machined Area} / {Profiling Rate} * {Machining Rate}

fields.name: Component Cost
fields.formula: {Punched Features} * ({Punch Cost} + {Button Cost} + {Retainer Cost} + {Stripper Pin Cost})

fields.name: Heat Treat Cost
fields.formula: {Heat Treat} * {Heat Treat Rate} * ({Shoe Steel Mass} + {Insert Steel Mass})

fields.name: Die Subtotal
fields.formula: {Design Cost} + {Assembly Cost} + {Shoe Cost} + {Component Cost} + {Insert Cost} + {Heat Treat Cost} + {Other Die Costs}
